items.description: Tag chips AI suggestion row. Individual + chips apply one at a time; Add all / Dismiss provide bulk actions. Supports read-only display mode.

items.name: enum-suggestion-row
items.title: EnumSuggestionRow

items.title: MultiEnumSuggestionRow
items.description: Multi-enum AI suggestion row with read-only and interactive modes.

items.name: date-suggestion-row
items.title: DateSuggestionRow
items.description: Date AI suggestion row with read-only and interactive modes.

items.name: preset-picker
items.title: PresetPicker
items.description: Preset selector that reads contract.presets and emits selected id.

items.name: user-prompt-field
items.title: UserPromptField
items.description: Labeled textarea for free-text AI instruction amendments.

items.name: diff-preview
items.title: DiffPreview
items.description: Before/after diff for a single field's text value.

items.name: write-policy-picker
items.title: WritePolicyPicker
items.description: Radio picker for preserve/replace/fill-if-empty/merge write policies.

items.name: capability-label
items.title: CapabilityLabel
items.description: In-flight action label e.g. "Proposing tags…" with spinner.

items.name: auto-apply-badge
items.title: AutoApplyBadge
items.description: Inline badge for auto-applied fields with hash, summary, and revert.

items.name: suggestion-trace-info
items.title: SuggestionTraceInfo
items.description: Popover showing TraceSummary scalars only — no payloads (ADR 0011).

items.name: file-input
items.title: FileInput
items.description: File upload input with drag-area trigger.

items.name: text-area-source
items.title: TextAreaSource
items.description: Textarea source for pasting text content.

items.name: prompt-input-source
items.title: PromptInputSource
items.description: Textarea for entering a free-form AI source prompt.

items.name: url-input
items.title: UrlInput
items.description: URL source input field.

items.name: tag-chips-input
items.title: TagChipsInput
items.description: Tag chips input with inline chip editor.

items.name: suggestions-options
items.title: SuggestionsOptions
items.description: Options panel composing PresetPicker, UserPromptField, and WritePolicyPicker with a Run button. Reads run state from SuggestionFlowProvider context. Pass showRunButton={false} when embedding inside IngestDialog.

items.name: file-text-prompt-source-picker
items.title: FileTextPromptSourcePicker
items.description: Tabbed three-way source input (file / text / prompt) that emits a controlled { kind, …payload } union. Reference block for IngestDialog source selection.

items.name: ingest-dialog
items.title: IngestDialog
items.description: Modal bundling FileTextPromptSourcePicker + SuggestionsOptions (options only) + post-run review body. Handles cold-fill and merge patterns. Wraps in SuggestionFlowProvider when flow prop is provided.

items.name: ai-suggestions-indicator
items.title: AiSuggestionsIndicator
items.description: Small widget showing idle / running / has-suggestions / mixed-auto-applied-with-review states with a counter (N auto-applied · M to review) and an Options affordance that opens SuggestionsOptions.

items.name: inline-field-suggestion
items.title: InlineFieldSuggestion
items.description: Per-field AI suggestion block that mounts adjacent to a form input. Dispatches by field kind via renderers prop. Ships defaultRenderers for text, array, enum, multi-enum, date. Supports single and choice (single/multi-pick) suggestion variants.

items.name: use-ai-suggestions
items.title: useAiSuggestions
items.description: Headless orchestration hook owning run state, per-field accept/reject/revert flows, viewed-field tracking, and accept-all gating.

items.name: suggestion-flow-provider
items.title: SuggestionFlowProvider
items.description: Context provider that hosts useAiSuggestions return for deep forms, with useSuggestionFlowContext() reader.

items.name: translate-entity-dialog
items.title: TranslateEntityDialog
items.description: Phase 1 atomic-create translation dialog. Two-call runFill (slug first for recipes/mixtures, then bulk) or one-call for ingredients/pairings. Composes InlineFieldSuggestion with sourceSlot. Primary CTA: Accept all & save draft.

items.name: create-pairing-dialog
items.title: CreatePairingDialog
items.description: Atomic-create pairing dialog seeded from an AI suggestion. Prefills both endpoints and rationale as editable description. Seeds featured=true for ingredient-only pairs, false for recipe/mixture-bearing pairs. Atomic save: new Pairing entity + meta + ingested aiEvent in one call.
